title: Lockup: Grand Rapids: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — And Baby Makes Three?
Behind the razor wire topped fences and brick walls of the Kent County Jail an inmate worker deals with the pressure of trying to create the jail's most popular dish; a pair of incarcerated lovers might end up having another mouth to feed.

title: Lockup: Grand Rapids: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Jailing
A gangbanger squares off with his victim's family in court and with another inmate inside the jail; the Kent County Jail staff must deal with a former colleague gone bad.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — The Hustle
Prison is an underground economy, where some deals are signed in ink and others are signed in blood; a rare look at the schemes, hustles and extortions conducted behind prison walls and the consequences they carry.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Pain
One reality of prison is that there's never a shortage of pain, and at the Limon Correctional Facility in Colorado, there's enough left over for the visitors as well; drama unfolds as a father and son try to reconcile a violent past.

title: Lockup: Wichita: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — The Keeper
An inmate with incredible artistic abilities is charged in tragic crime; another inmate's seeming obsession with jail food causes problems; an unconventional marriage ends violently.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S6 E6 — SEG
Solitary confinement is one of the most common methods for disciplining inmates, but it's also a very controversial issue.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S4 E3 — The Flip Side
A U.S. Marine violates the code and now faces a murder charge; a would-be soccer mom takes up with a violent street gang; an openly gay inmate adheres to the convict code and pays the price.

title: American Greed
description:
S8 E4 — $udden Death; Hip Hop Hustle
A successful financial advisor's world crumbles under a multi-million dollar scam; a Chicago-area rapper convinces a local businessman that he's got a new gig that doesn't exist.

title: American Greed
description:
S11 E16 — Wine, Women and Fraud
A man steals millions from rich wine clients, and spends the money on fast cars and faster hookups, until he himself falls prey to a scheme.

title: American Greed
description:
S7 E3 — The Prisoner of Wall Street
A man is convicted of wire fraud and money laundering after claiming to sell coffee futures.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Homecoming
Extractions provide some of the most dramatic interactions that ever occur between inmates and staff, and few extractions in the state of Colorado have provided more drama than the ones involving Roy Slagle.

title: Lockup: Sacramento: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Starz and Zillas
One alleged gang leader is charged with assault shortly after his arrest and now his arch-rival has been booked into the jail as well; an admitted identity thief and meth addict clings to hope for a better life.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S4 E6 — Word to the Wise
Using inmates to turn troubled teens away from a life of crime; inmates express their regrets.

title: Lockup Special Investigation
description:
S1 E3 — Lake County Juvenile Justice: Kevin, Kymyada
Juvenile Court Judge Mary Beth Bonaventura observes that an indicator of what will happen in a child's life can be found by looking at the family and how supportive it has been; the kids seem to know this, too.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Da Future
With over 2,000 inmates, the Wabash Valley Correctional Facility has a larger population and more acreage than the small town in which it's located; after a decade in confinement, one of Indiana's most infamous inmates moves to general population.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Father Figure
The killer of a corrections officer fights to be freed from 16 years of solitary confinement, and boyhood friends struggle to parent their kids from behind prison walls; but one, cut-off from visits with his son, is on a razor's edge.

title: Lockup: Tampa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Mother Knows Best?
A convict finds that jail offers a chance for revenge, a former stripper fears losing her daughter, and you'll get a "taste" of Tampa behind bars.

title: Lockup: Sacramento: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — The Eyes Have It
Just weeks away from completing his sentence, an inmate is accused of murdering his cellie; a large woman with a personality to match loses everything to meth; an inmate causes a disturbance on the jail's transfer bus.

title: Lockup: Cincinnati: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Message in a Bottle
A jailhouse assault leads to one bloody inmate, and two sides to the story; another inmate makes a daring escape; one of the jail's most violent inmates decides it's time for a change.
